from collections import Counter
artist_counter = Counter()
for item in all_items:
    for a in item.get('artists', []):
        artist_counter[a['name']] += 1
print('unique_artists', len(artist_counter))
most_common = artist_counter.most_common(10)
print('top10', most_common)
if most_common:
    top_artist, top_count = most_common[0]
    print('top_artist', top_artist)
    print('top_count', top_count)
